name: Zics (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Zics: a crowned red and blue shield with a patriarchal cross and a bunch of grapes, within a yellow baroque frame.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Zics arms with crown and frame
